'''October 2000 Parker tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Parker, Colorado on 21 October 2000. [[Brian Hunter]] won it. It is known from Brian Hunter's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1371">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-22-parker-co-10-21-00-total-carnaged1371/ parker-co-10-21-00-total-carnage], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 22 October 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-10-22-parker-co-10-21-00-total-carnaged1371/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 21 October 2000
* '''Site:''' Parker, Colorado
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Death Star II]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]
